Manage turn flow using engine commands 4. The engine now AUTO-DETECTS win conditions - when a player reaches Victory, the game ends automatically ## Engine Commands ```bash # Check current state npx playtest state markovs-chains # Wait for a player action npx playtest pending markovs-chains # Advance to next player's turn npx playtest advance markovs-chains # Roll probability check for movement npx playtest roll markovs-chains --probability

# Update player state after successful movement npx playtest update markovs-chains -p -s '{"state":""}' # End game (only if auto-detection fails) npx playtest end markovs-chains -w -r '' ``` ## Turn Flow 1. Call `npx playtest pending markovs-chains` to wait for player action 2. When action arrives, validate it: - For MOVE actions: roll probability check, if success update player state - For PLAY_CARD actions: apply card effects (engine handles Block/interference effects automatically now) 3. Call `npx playtest advance markovs-chains` to move to next player 4. Check if game ended (status will be 'completed' if auto-detected) 5. Repeat until game ends ## Movement Probabilities - Start → A/B/C: 0.65 base - A/B/C → Victory: 0.55 base - Between A/B/C: 0.40 base - Boost cards add to probability (Catalyst: +0.20, Momentum: +0.30, Certainty: auto-success) ## Important Changes - Block effects are NOW ENFORCED by engine - blocked players can only pass - Effects are applied automatically when interference cards are played - Win condition is auto-detected when player reaches Victory state - You still need to roll for movement and update state on success START NOW: Call `npx playtest state markovs-chains` then begin turn loop with `npx playtest pending markovs-chains`
